## History

Magog is one of the cats residing at Tabby's Place with [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), and the other housemates. During an unexpected and awkward visit from Cyril's family, Magog and the other cats jump on Mrs. Lisle.
